subject: Deal Ignite — credit ask (OliveTech)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Deal Ignite - request: small credit to close OliveTech

Hey Irene / Grace,

Quick context: OliveTech (platform + integrations) is at the finish line on a 6-month pilot. Usage profile is front-loaded (heavy first 30 days) and they're asking for a short promotional credit to hit their internal procurement cutoff this week. Current committed ARR if converted: ~$180k. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/OLV-2027-239

Customer ask: $12,000 in usage credits applied as a one-time billing credit for the first invoice if they sign by 2026-07-28. They said procurement will greenlight with this concession.

Attached: EOQ_Credit_Proposal_v1.pdf (proposal & reasoning).

Asking for a quick thumbs up from revenue leadership and finance pathing. If we do this, we capture the full ARR and get a reference customer in healthcare integration space.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm approval or propose limit (Irene)
- Marissa to draft T&C amendment
- Route to Finance for final posting mechanism

Thanks,
Ben
--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal Ignite - request: small credit to close OliveTech

Ben — thanks for the context. A couple quick asks before I can sign off:

1) Can you quantify the expected net-new ARR vs. churn risk if we do nothing (one-liner).
2) Confirm whether the credit is refundable or applied only as a billing credit (preferred).
3) Please add the customer point-of-contact in the thread so we have direct confirmation on timing.

I favor a time-limited, billing-credit structure (not cash) and a clear expiry window (60-90 days). Marissa — can you draft the amendment (one page) and include acceptance language? Grace — FYI on P&L impact; happy to route to finance once we have the draft.

If we can get answers quickly, I'm open to approving up to $15k conditional on Marissa/Finance confirming the posting method.

Irene
--
Irene Choi
Revenue Director | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal Ignite - request: small credit to close OliveTech

Irene / Ben — draft attached (credit_terms_draft.docx). Proposed structure based on usage & finance guidance: 

- Offer: $12,000 usage credit applied as an invoice credit to the first paid invoice after conversion.
- Validity: credit must be consumed within 90 days of invoice issuance.
- Conditions: credit applied only to usage charges (not support or professional services).
- One-time, non-refundable accounting credit.

Financial impact: this is an upfront hit to recognized revenue in month 1 but converts to full ARR thereafter; modeled as a contra-revenue credit of $12k (impact acceptable within our Q3 plan).

Ben — please confirm the customer point-of-contact and procurement deadline (Ben: can you loop Sam from OliveTech?). Once they confirm timing, I can convert this into a DocuSign amendment and share for Finance posting.

Marissa

Sam Park <sam.park@olivetech.com> (external): Please confirm in-thread that the proposed $12,000 usage credit, applied to the first invoice and valid for 90 days, is acceptable and you will proceed with the signature by 7/28.

Attachment: OliveTech_feedback.txt (notes from procurement call).

Thanks — Ben

Thanks team — based on the draft and urgency I am authorizing the following, conditional on Finance posting and the customer signing the amendment by 2026-07-28: 

Approved concession (Irene Choi, Revenue Director):
- $12,000 one-time usage billing credit applied to OliveTech's first paid invoice after conversion.
- Credit must be used within 90 days and applies only to usage charges.
- Non-refundable; recorded as contra-revenue per standard practice.

Action items: 
- Marissa: convert the draft into a DocuSign amendment and add the acceptance clause. Related link: https://docusign.example.com/12345
- Grace: confirm GL posting code and cash-account impact; please confirm by EOD 2026-07-27 so we can dispatch.
- Ben: confirm Sam's signature and upload the executed amendment to HubSpot (deal OLV-2027-239).

Once Finance confirms posting method, consider this closed and proceed to finalize paperwork. Thank you all for the fast turnaround — landing this now materially moves our Q3 target.

Irene
